screening.interpretation: The 45 promoted records are a material annual shortlist, not an attempt to enumerate every 2021 model, paper, region, or benchmark.

residual_limitations: Ten monthly cs.LG query slices hit the configured 2,000-result cap, so the broad arXiv intake is not a completeness proof; material anchors were protected by exact-identity checks and targeted gap fill.
Present-day official indexes cannot prove that every 2021 publisher item remains linked or byte-identical to its original publication state.

The configured GitHub Release watchlist produced no normalized 2021 release records and is oriented toward projects material in later years; commit-level runtime history is not reconstructed exhaustively.
Supplemental first-party pages establish publisher-defined announcement, access, or release boundaries; vendor capability claims remain attributed rather than independently reproduced.

single_volume_assessment.rationale: The reviewed evidence forms one coherent annual transition: pretrained models became reusable substrates surrounded by adaptation/steering, multimodal generation, code interfaces, access/distribution surfaces, scale/systems/retrieval design, and explicit evaluation/risk layers. The trajectories interact strongly enough to support one annual volume and connect naturally to the 2022-Y architecture without requiring an H1/H2 split.
